chapters.reason: The paper explicitly maps hidden states to condensed 'gist tokens' to replace verbose reasoning chains, which aligns with the definition of reasoning in latent space.
The method involves training the model to compress reasoning chains and uses specialized attention masks to manage the context window, fitting the compression-focused training approach.
The paper introduces a new 'Dependency (Dep) metric' specifically to quantify the degree of compression and efficiency in reasoning tasks.
